data.title: 爱宕 · 清晨床畔的温柔唤醒
data.description: 阳光柔和地洒在卧室床头，爱宕系着围裙俯身坐在床沿。她嘴角含着无尽宠溺的笑意，玉手轻柔拂开你额前的碎发，黑色犬耳欢快地微动，厨房飘来早点的醇香。
data.location: sunlit master bedroom in the morning
data.action: leaning over bed with affectionate pampering smile, gently brushing hair from partner forehead, dog ears perking up happily, breakfast aroma from kitchen
data.lighting: warm gentle morning sunshine filtering through sheer white curtains
data.mood: sweet domestic awakening, overwhelming maternal care, tender love
data.promptProse: Leaning over the bed in an apron in morning sunlight, Atago smiles with pure pampering devotion, gently brushing hair from partner forehead.
data.animaCaption: Atago gently waking up her partner with a loving smile in a sunlit bedroom.
